author: Cmasi

author: Ulises Icardi
attribution: Photo: Ulises Icardi, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Coronel_Bogado_es_conocida_como_la_%22Capital_Nacional_del_Chipa%22.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large illustrated 3D town letters in a park in Coronel Bogado (Itapúa) on a plinth reading 'CAPITAL NACIONAL DEL CHIPA' with the I of NACIONAL missing. The first word (presumably 'CNEL.') is seen edge-on and painted with pictures, so it is not legible and is left out; 'BOGADO' letters are also painted with scenes (house, cart, chipa seller).
source_title: File:Coronel Bogado es conocida como la "Capital Nacional del Chipa".jpg
